environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on an EC2 instance (not in Kubernetes) with an attached IAM instance profile 'render-worker-role'. The instance metadata service v1 (IMDSv1) is enabled. No network restrictions between the application and 169.254.169.254. Application runs as a systemd service with direct network access.

config.network: no egress filtering, security group allows all outbound
config.deployment: systemd service, port 8080 exposed via ALB
